correctness.rationale: The exact 2-adic valuation formula follows from the defining morphism. For a prescribed 2^k displacement, every coordinate except the unique multiple-of-2^k coordinate is unchanged; equality of Parikh vectors is thus literal block equality. The remaining exceptional letters equal 1-(k+v2(j) mod 2), so two or three can coincide but four cannot, and the only repeated block is the stated primitive word. Density counting of even valuation classes gives 1/3 and 1/6. Direct substitution-based factor enumerations for k<=8/e=2..5 and independent valuation-based local checks for k<=10 passed. Computer checks are finite and are not substituted for the all-length proof.

broader_coverage.reasoning: The general recurrence/existence theorem guarantees large Abelian powers at some periods under bounded abelian complexity, compatible with the absence of such powers for specifically dyadic periods. The cyclic-complexity theorem shows two conjugacy classes but has no implication fixing exact repetitions or their occurrence frequencies.

value.rationale: This solves a natural structural question at every dyadic block scale in a classical Toeplitz automatic word: characterize all Abelian powers, count their distinct factors, and give exact densities of each factor. It exhibits strong Abelian-to-literal rigidity despite the existence of non-dyadic Abelian fourth powers, sharply identifying the scope of the phenomenon. These specific invariants are relevant to studying abelian repetition statistics and are not arbitrary numeric slices or known-table recomputations.
